title: The 5-cycle has no independent set of three vertices
statement: Let $C_5$ denote the cycle graph on five vertices, in which the vertices are arranged in a ring and each vertex is adjacent exactly to its two neighbours. Then $C_5$ contains no independent set of three vertices; that is, no three of its vertices are pairwise non-adjacent.
hypotheses_covered: independence number bound: no independent set of size 3
replaced:
\emph{The 5-cycle contains no
independent set of three vertices.}

The 5-cycle (figure 7.2a) contains no clique of three vertices and no
independent set of three vertices.
